questions.stem: Mrs. Szubanska has made a great contribution to our company through ------- wide knowledge and practical, down-to-earth approach.
questions.translation: 祖班斯卡女士凭借她广博的知识和实用、务实的方法为我们公司做出了巨大的贡献。
questions.explanation: 备选答案均为同一人称的不同人称代词，因此需要分析横线前后的具体结构。横线后有名词短语wide knowledge (形容词+名词)，因此横线处所填代词应和wide一起修饰knowledge。故选形容词性物主代词 (D) her。

questions.stem: The lunch menu today consists of a choice of ------- chicken or pork served with a salad or vegetables.
questions.translation: 今天的午餐菜单上有搭配沙拉或者蔬菜的鸡肉和猪肉，可以任选其一。
questions.explanation: 横线后的chicken和pork由or连接，因此可判断是 either...or...的结构。答案是 (C)。both...and...， neither...nor...，not only...but also...等结构也经常出现在试题中。

questions.stem: A committee of senior managers has designed a new interest rate schedule that it believes will ------- many new investors.
questions.translation: 高层管理委员会设计了一个自认为能吸引许多新投资者的新利率表。
questions.explanation: it believes是插入语，可省略。will ______ many new investors的动作实施者是a new interest rate schedule，因此“吸引很多新投资者”的句意最恰当。答案是 (C) attract (吸引，引起注意)。

questions.stem: The ------- of the most recent customer satisfaction survey are generally positive, and we would like to congratulate all of our employees.
questions.translation: 最近的顾客满意度调查的结果整体比较乐观，因此我们想祝贺所有的员工。
questions.explanation: 横线处所填单词被介词短语of the most recent customer satisfaction survey (最近的顾客满意度调查) 修饰，因此“最近的顾客

questions.stem: Senior managers assured investigators that ------- no time were they aware of illegal activities in their Accounting Department.
questions.translation: 高层经理向调查员保证他们对财务部的不法行为毫不知情。
questions.explanation: 在本文中，that从句的语序是“谓语+主语”，而非“主语 +谓语”，可见采用了倒装，因此______ no time应作状语。句意应为“他们对财务部的不法行为毫不知情”，故选 (A) at。at no time意为“绝不，从不”。

questions.stem: As part of the takeover agreement, the new owners have agreed to ------- the existing senior managers.
questions.translation: 作为收购协议的一部分，新业主已经同意保留现有的高级管理人员。
questions.explanation: 根据as part of the takeover agreement (作为收购协议的一部分)、have agreed to (同意)，以及充当横线处所填单词宾语的the existing senior managers (现有的高层管理人员) 等内容判断，最恰当的是 (C) retain (保留，保持)。

questions.stem: Investors should realistically ------- the potential of any startup before investing their hard-earned funds.
questions.translation: 投资者在用自己辛苦挣来的钱进行投资前，应该客观地评估新兴公司的潜力。
questions.explanation: 句意应为“投资者应客观地评估…”，故选 (C) evaluate (估计，评价)。(A) 一般用于compensate for (对…进行补偿) 的结构， (B) 一般用于convince...that... (使…相信…)、convince...of... (使…相信…)、convince sb. to do (说服某人做某事) 等结构。

questions.stem: Employees wishing to ------- professional congresses or seminars will continue to receive their pay during the time they are absent.
questions.translation: 有意参加专业会议或者研讨会的员工在缺勤期间将继续获得工资。
questions.explanation: (A) 应与介词in连用构成enroll in (登记，招收)；(C) 也应与介词in连用构成participate in (参加，参与)；(D) 可直接后接宾语，但不符合句意。“想参加专业会议或研讨会的…”的句意最恰当，故选 (B) attend (参加)。

questions.stem: If ------- has found a wallet containing cash and valuable papers, could that person please hand it in to the security desk.
questions.translation: 如果有人捡到一个装有现金和有价证券的钱包，可否将其交到保安处？
questions.explanation: has是第三人称单数，故排除复数 (C) they。反身代词 (D) oneself不能独立作句子的主语，因此也排除。“如果有人捡到装有现金和有价证券的钱包…”的句意最恰当，因此答案是 (A) anyone。(B) everyone虽然在语法上符合要求，但是“如果每个人捡到…”的句意不符合逻辑。

questions.stem: The Business Advisory Council has been specifically designed for those in --- ---- of advice about setting up new businesses.
questions.translation: 商业咨询委员会是为那些需要创业指导的人士特别设立的。
questions.explanation: 句意应为“针对创业需要指导的人士”，故选 (A) need。in need of意为“需要…”。

questions.stem: Payment of telephone or Internet orders is ------- within 7 working days of the receipt of the goods and invoice.
questions.translation: 电话订购或者网上订购需要在收到货物和发票后的7个工作日内付款。
questions.explanation: 句意应为“应在收到货物和发票后7个工作日内付款”，故选 (A) due (应支付的)。

questions.stem: The organizing committee has not yet set a ------- date for the seminar, but it will be some time in the first week of November.
questions.translation: 组织委员会还未给研讨会定下具体的日期，但会议将在11月的第一周举行。
questions.explanation: “还没有决定研讨会的具体日期”的句意最恰当，故选 (D) specific (具体的，特定的)。

questions.stem: The new head of marketing has been criticized for being too ------- to please senior managers.
questions.translation: 市场部的新经理太单纯，不能使高层管理人员满意。
questions.explanation: for being too ______ to please senior managers是the new head of marketing受到指责的原因，因此应表达出“太单纯，不能使高层管理人员满意”的句意。答案是 (D) simple。too...to do (太…以至于不能做某事)。

questions.stem: The main ------- of completing a postgraduate business qualification is that it allows you to make valuable contacts in related fields.
questions.translation: 获得商业研究生学位证书的主要好处就是让你在相关行业积累重要的人脉资源。
questions.explanation: that it allows you to make valuable contacts in related fields (帮助你在相关行业积累重要的人脉资源) 属于有利因素，故选 (C) advantage (优势，有利条件)。

questions.stem: All female employees are advised to be ------- when entering and leaving the building after-hours due to a recent spate of attacks.
questions.translation: 由于最近发生的一连串袭击事件，所有女性员工都被建议在下班后进出大楼时要非常小心。
questions.explanation: 横线前有be，横线后有when引导的时间状语从句，因此横线处应填入名词或形容词作表语。若选名词，主句的语意不连贯，故选表示主语状态的形容词 (B) cautious。

questions.stem: At the last meeting, many enquiries were made ------- the proposed shift in the company’s mission statement.
questions.translation: 在上次会议中，很多人询问关于改变公司使命宣言的提案。
questions.explanation: the proposed shift in the company’s mission statement是enquiries (询问) 的对象，故选介词 (B) regarding (关于)。

questions.stem: As you are aware, a wide range of issues was ------- at the meeting last Thursday, and I am pleased to announce that several action committees have already been set up.
questions.translation: 正如你们所知，上周四的会议上讨论了一系列问题，而且我很高兴地宣布几个行动委员会已经成立了。
questions.explanation: a wide range of issues是discuss的宾语，因此这里应该使用被动语态。答案是 (B) discussed。

questions.stem: Answering mobile phone calls while you are at a work meeting is not only discourteous, but it can also destroy the ------- of the meeting.
questions.translation: 在工作会议上接听手机不仅不礼貌，而且会破坏会议的效果。
questions.explanation: 会议中接听电话不仅是一种没有礼貌的行为，而且会影响会议的顺利进行。最符合句意的是 (B) efficacy (效率，功效)。

questions.stem: Entry to the seminar is restricted to those who have received a personal ------- from the general manager.
questions.translation: 只有那些受到总经理个人邀请的人才能参加此次研讨会。
questions.explanation: 句意应为“只有那些受到总经理个人邀请的人”，答案是 (C) invitation (邀请，招待)。

questions.stem: ------- recent changes in government small business regulations, we will be holding a series of practical workshops to assist owners and managers.
Mr. Smith wants you to know that he will be ------- job applicants all day on Thursday, and that all enquiries should be directed to his secretary.
questions.translation: 史密斯先生想让你知道他周四全天都要面试求职者，所有问题都跟他的秘书说。

questions.stem: All possible ------- will be taken to ensure that this mine is entirely accident and injury-free.
questions.translation: 我们将采取一切可能的措施来确保这个矿井完全不会造成事故或人员伤亡。
questions.explanation: job applicants充当interview的宾语，且横线前有be，故选 (D) interviewing。将来进行时 (will be doing) 用于描述主语确信的、将来肯定会发生的事情。

questions.stem: The selection committee will consider applications from any employee ------- to apply for these positions.
questions.translation: 选拔委员会将考虑来自任何有资格应聘这些职位的员工的申请。
questions.explanation: ______ to apply for these positions修饰any employee，因此要表达出“有资格应聘这些职位”的句意。答案是 (C) eligible (合格的，符合条件的)。

questions.stem: Our rapid courier service guarantees to ------- your urgent documents anywhere within the city limits within an hour of pickup.
questions.translation: 只要在本市范围内，我们迅捷的快递服务保证在取件后的1小时内送达您的紧急文件。
questions.explanation: “保证紧急文件在1小时内送达”的句意最恰当，故选 (B) deliver (运送)。(C) commute (通勤) 和 (D) respond (回答，响应) 是不及物动词，后接宾语时要加介词to。

questions.stem: It won’t be ------- to take notes during the seminar, as we will be handing out detailed summaries.
questions.translation: 在研讨会期间没有必要记笔记，因为我们会分发详细摘要。
questions.explanation: 根据原因状语从句as we will be handing out detailed summaries (我们会分发详细摘要) 判断，句意应为“会议期间不需要记笔记”。答案是 (C) necessary (必需的，必要的)。

questions.stem: Management experts consider it highly ------- that internal communications not only be ‘top-down’.
questions.translation: 管理专家认为内部交流不应该仅限于“自上而下”。
questions.explanation: 本句具有“consider +形式宾语it + 副词 (highly) +宾语补足语+真正宾语”的结构。宾语补足语对宾语的特征、状态等情况进行补充说明，故选形容词 (B) desirable。

questions.stem: Fine Fare is a journal devoted ------- to the subject of exquisite foods and wines from all over the world.
questions.translation: 《美食》是一本专门以世界各地的食物与美酒为主题的刊物。
questions.explanation: “专门以世界各地的美食与美酒为主题的刊物”的句意最恰当，故选 (D) exclusively (专门地，专有地)。

questions.stem: During high school, Richard was ------- by his uncompromising determination to win at any cost.
questions.translation: 在高中的时候，理查德就因其永不妥协、不惜一切获胜的决心而出名。
questions.explanation: 句意应为“理查德以…而与众不同”，故选 (B) distinguished (与众不同的)。

questions.stem: Should you have ------- regarding the new contracts, don’t hesitate to contact your union representative.
questions.translation: 如果您对新合同有任何疑虑，请直接联系工会代表。
questions.explanation: 横线处所填单词被介词短语regarding the new contracts (有关新合同的) 修饰，最符合句意的名词是 (B) concerns。

questions.stem: Could you please tell Mr. Parsons that I tried to contact him ------- this morning, but there was no answer at the number he gave me.
questions.translation: 您可否告诉帕森斯先生我今天上午多次尝试联系他，但是他给我的号码一直没有人接听？
questions.explanation: 根据but there was no answer at the number he gave me (但是他给我的电话号码没有人接听) 和I tried to contact him (我试着联系他) 判断，最符合句意的是 (D) repeatedly (再三，多次)。

passages.title: Your Invitation to saturdays@artswave
passages.text: Your Invitation to saturdays@artswave Scenario Saturday, casual wear, inspired space, scented oils, soothing music, ambient lighting, warm cups of green tea, lost in the experience, sketch the day away… pure bliss. Saturday is an excellent day to lose (131) -------- in a creative activity at Artswave. (132) --------. Absolutely no talent is needed. And we have (133) ----- --- our special offer, so you will still save $20. Between now and November 30, all experiences are just $79 (except life drawing). But hurry, (134) -------- places are available. saturdays@artswave 10 a.m.–2:30 p.m. Light lunch included. Unwind your mind at www.artswave.com/escape. Or phone 1-800-755-4554 for a free catalogue.

questions.explanation: 这是面向大众的广告，因此最恰当的是 (D) yourself。

options.A: All experiences are designed for complete beginners.
options.B: The activity is designed for only professional artists.
options.C: All experiences will cost over $80, including life drawing.
options.D: Unlimited places are available from now to November 30.

questions.explanation: 由下句“不需要任何天赋”可知，横线处说该活动适用于初学者，故选 (A)。
连词so连接因果关系的两个句子，因此横线处所填单词应表示you will still save $20 (您还可以省20美元) 的理由。答案是 (C) extended。
之所以要尽快申请，是因为名额有限。答案是 (D) limited。

passages.title: Dear Samantha,
passages.text: Dear Samantha, I am writing in regard to Mimi Stone. I had the privilege of meeting her during my last visit to the Singapore Business Conference. I have heard recently that she left Global Tech about a month ago. This is a good thing because we are currently in search of someone like her for our new business prospects with your company. I know it may still be premature to conclude on the new business; however, we have met her, and she seems well versed in the operations part of our business. We are strongly considering her as a potential operations manager, but we need your feedback as (135) --------. I am doing a background (136) -------- on her and want to know if she is worthwhile to hire. (137) --------. If you are not familiar with her, could you talk to Jack Ryan, her ex-boss for me? I think you will get a much better (138) -------- from him since you’ve done business with Global Tech in the past. Thank you. Best regards, Jeffrey Hill Director of Planning & Business Development Group, BASE ON-ROUTE INC.

questions.explanation: (A) settlement意为“解决”，(B) selection意为“选择，挑选”，(C) connection意为“连接”，(D) reference意为“参考，参照”。最符合句意的是 (D)。
a background ______要充当doing的宾语，因此横线处应填入名词单数。答案是 (A) check。do a background check意为“做背景调查”。

options.A: She was an employer in the Global Tech one year ago.
options.B: Jack Ryan has been her boss for two years.
options.C: She is considered as an excellent operations manager.
options.D: If you do know anything about her, your reference will be of great value.

questions.explanation: 由下句“如果您对她不了解，能否……”可知，横线处是说“如果您确实了解她……”，故选 (D)。
根据前文内容，最恰当的是 (A) answer。

passages.title: DEL PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, INC. is pleased and (139) -------- once
passages.text: DEL PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, INC. is pleased and (139) -------- once again to have received the Consumers’ Choice Award for excellence in Residential Property Management and also congratulates the deserving (140) ---- ---- in all the other categories. (141) --------. They have been a constant source of (142) -------- in our unwavering pursuit of excellence throughout our more than 50 years in business. DEL PROPERTY MANAGEMENT, INC. Specializing in Professional Condominium Property Management Services

questions.explanation: 答案是 (B) proud。be proud to do意为“为做…而感到自豪”。

options.A: They have contributed a lot to this award in the past more than 50 years.
options.B: This award is also a tribute to our loyal and valued clients, owners and staff.
options.C: Del Property Management, Inc. has won the award many times.
options.D: Two companies have won this Consumers’ Choice Award.

questions.explanation: 下句说“他们……是我们永恒的动力源泉”。由此可知，横线处是在表达对“他们”帮助该公司获奖的感激之情，故选 (B)。
根据上下文，这里是说“他们的鼓励是我们永恒的动力源泉”，故选 (C)。

passages.title: ENTER TO WIN!
passages.text: ENTER TO WIN! 4 tickets to the Blue Jays in (143) -------- at the Sky Dome and 4 passes to CN Tower, plus a $100 gift card to be used at the CN Tower restaurant overlooking the beautiful city of Toronto! To (144) --------, please send an e-mail to entertowin@tor.com with your name, address, and phone number and write subject line: A day in Toronto. If you are interested in receiving more information about Downsview Park Events, please include YES in your e-mail (145) --------. Visit www.dp.com for more information! (146) --------.

questions.explanation: 句意应为“想报名参加，请…”，故选 (B) enter。表示参加比赛、大会、活动等的动词用enter。
句意应为“在提交邮件时注明‘是’”，故选 (D) submission。(A) solicitation (恳求，恳请) 和 (C) subjection (征服，屈从) 都不符合句意。

options.A: Contest closes on Friday, October 6 at 9 P.M.
options.B: Over 100 gift cards are available in this contest.
options.C: Winners are free to eat at the CN Tower restaurant.
options.D: Only 4 free passes to the CN Tower are available.

questions.explanation: 前三段都没有提及比赛的截止日期。横线处填“本次比赛将于10月6 日 (周五) 晚上9点结束”能与上文内容相呼应，故选 (A)。

passages.title: Leonard Grubbs [1:35 P.M.]
passages.text: Leonard Grubbs [1:35 P.M.] Hi, Clarice. The deliveryman called me about a package that’s coming, but I’m at the courthouse. Can you sign for it, please? Clarice Deacon [1:36 P.M.] How soon should he be here? Leonard Grubbs [1:37 P.M.] He said he’d be in our office in about fifteen minutes. Why do you ask? Clarice Deacon [1:39 P.M.] I’m supposed to attend a meeting with the department heads at 2:00. Leonard Grubbs [1:40 P.M.] If he doesn’t come by then, could you ask Dennis to take care of this? I really need the documents in that package. Clarice Deacon [1:41 P.M.] Of course. I’ll make sure you get it.

questions.stem: At 1:36 P.M., what does Ms. Deacon most likely imply when she writes,“How soon should he be here?”

options.C: She just arrived in the office.
options.D: She is preparing to go home.

questions.translation: 下午1点36分，迪肯女士写：“他要多久能到这儿？”她最可能要暗示什么？ (A) 她很快要去赴约。 (B) 她看不见快递员。 (C) 她刚到办公室。 (D) 她正准备回家。
questions.explanation: 迪肯女士问了这一问题后，格拉布斯先生问她为什么这么问？她回复说，她两点钟需要和部门主任开会，而两人发信息的时间是1点39分左右，由此可知她很快要去开会。答案是 (A)。

questions.stem: What is suggested about Dennis?

options.A: He regularly delivers packages to Mr. Grubbs.
options.B: He is an employee in the mailroom.
options.C: He is attending the meeting with Ms. Deacon.
options.D: He works in the same office as Mr. Grubbs.

questions.translation: 关于丹尼斯，文章暗示了什么？ (A) 他定期给格拉布斯先生送包裹。 (B) 他是收发室的员工。 (C) 他正和迪肯女士开会。 (D) 他和格拉布斯先生在同一个办公室工作。
questions.explanation: 格拉布斯先生说快递员会送包裹到办公室，并请求迪肯女士，如果她无法签收，就请丹尼斯帮忙签收，由此可知格拉布斯先生、迪肯女士和丹尼斯都在一个办公室工作。答案是 (D)。

passages.title: Opportunity for International Experience
passages.text: Opportunity for International Experience Currently we have four positions open for middle managers who wish to participate in a six-month, international exchange program. The program will involve sharing with our counterparts in the respective country best practice principles learned while on the job here in our head office. During your brief excursion, you will spend a considerable amount of time learning about the domestic branches’ markets, with a specific focus on market research in the area of domestic consumers’ preferences. Afterwards, a comprehensive report of our research results will be submitted to the head office on your return. Interested applicants must fill out an application in addition to submitting a maximum two-page essay on the benefits of participating in an international exchange and how that experience can add value to the corporation. The deadline to apply is October 31.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the notice?

options.A: To announce the promotion of some managers
options.B: To invite staff members to the international conference
options.C: To request a report on the domestic market 1148
options.D: To recruit people interested in participating in a special program

questions.translation: 这个通知的目的是什么？ (A) 宣布一些经理升职 (B) 邀请员工参加国际会议 (C) 要求写一份国内市场报告 (D) 招募有意参加特殊项目的人
questions.explanation: 这个通知是为了招募自愿参加国际交流项目的中层管理者。答案是 (D)。

questions.stem: What must be turned in at the end of the six-month period?
questions.translation: 在为期半年的项目结束时必须上交什么？ (A) 一篇文章 (B) 一张申请表 (C) 一份报告 (D) 课程费
questions.explanation: 参加完交流项目之后需要提交研究报告。答案是 (C)。

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT required to be done by the applicants?

options.B: Write about what they have learned
options.C: Provide a reason for their application
options.D: Get permission from their immediate managers

questions.translation: 以下哪项不要求申请人做？ (A) 填一张表格 (B) 写一下这个项目如何利于公司发展 (C) 提供申请理由 (D) 从他们的直接上级那里获得批准
questions.explanation: 通知的最后一段列出了申请人所要提交的资料。fill out an application对应 (A)，how that experience can add value to the corporation对应 (B)，two-page essay on the benefits of participating in an international exchange对应 (C)。申请人不需要做的是 (D)。

passages.title: To: charles@danone.com
passages.text: To: charles@danone.com From: jgibson@kalpine.net Subject: Upcoming visit Dear Charles, The purpose of this letter is to confirm the travel dates for Sharon and myself. We had some difficulty working out our schedules but have finally agreed that the best time for our trip would be from February 14 to 21. passages.title: The legal dispute between Frecopy and Dwean has yet to reach a
passages.text: The legal dispute between Frecopy and Dwean has yet to reach a conclusion. Talks between each side’s legal representatives have been ensuing for about a month now. They were close to a settlement about a week ago but have since slid back from their earlier talks due to new information that has been released by the FDA. The FDA announced the discovery of a substance in both companys’ migraine medication mix that exceeds the daily recommended amount by 12%. The major area of dispute is that Frecopy claims that they legally licensed the use of the main substances from Dwean to make the medication for minors; however, they claim they were unaware of the legal dosage required under the FDA regulations since Dwean is the main applicant with the FDA. However, Dwean claims Frecopy was fully aware of the legal dosage in talks prior to the actual licensing agreement signing. Recently, analysts have downgraded both companies in their equity reports and say that the two companies should proceed with caution and do their best to work out a settlement with the FDA and each other quickly and quietly. Any long, dragged out, legal disputes with the FDA and the state prosecutor’s office could truly hurt both companies’ long-term profitability.
